name: Welcome screen enters the dashboard
description: Verifies the screenshot-inspired welcome screen leads to the separate dashboard view.
steps: Confirm the security dashboard and bottom navigation appear
expected: The dashboard opens with the scanned-links gauge, risk tiles, summary rows and navigation.

name: Dashboard opens the link scanner and creates a result
description: Verifies a suspicious shortened link produces a visible scan result in the matching dark neon interface.
steps: Tap Scan in the bottom navigation
expected: The Link Scan Result section appears with a shortened-link warning and risk indicator.

name: Message scan flags credential requests
description: Verifies a message asking for an OTP and password is identified as a critical warning.
steps: Paste a message asking for an OTP and password
expected: The result displays a critical sensitive-information warning.

name: Empty scan input is blocked
description: Verifies scanning cannot start until a link or message is entered.
expected: The scan button is disabled and no result is generated.

name: History and settings navigation work
description: Verifies the remaining navigation destinations open their own separate views.
steps: Confirm the empty history state is visible
Confirm privacy and security information appears
expected: History and Settings each display their own page rather than being combined into the dashboard.
